requirements: Every emitted public document has one main landmark, one static h1 fallback, a valid skip target, a viewport declaration and no duplicate id.
Every emitted public document is assigned to one responsive layout owner.
Compact, standard, wide, portrait, landscape, short-landscape and standalone PWA states are source-defined.
Keyboard, pointer, touch, controller and voice input are descriptive capability states, never automatic permission or execution claims.
Coarse-pointer controls have a shared 44 CSS-pixel minimum target foundation.
Keyboard focus remains visibly outlined, including forced-colors mode.
Reduced-motion preferences disable smooth scrolling and collapse non-essential animation duration.
Native form validation is announced and aria-invalid is removed after a valid edit.
The shared bridge must not request media, sensors, fullscreen, orientation lock, controller polling or network access.
Source certification remains separate from real physical-device, browser, zoom, assistive-technology and PWA evidence.
physicalEvidenceRequired: iPhone Safari portrait and landscape safe areas
installed PWA display mode and update transition
screen reader landmark, name, state and error announcements
real controller mapping and disconnect behavior
browser speech availability and typed fallback
